subject.title: [Bug]: Agent shows generic error when model auth fails - no fallback, no useful error message

question: Should authentication failure of a session-pinned model remain a terminal error with actionable recovery, or may OpenClaw automatically abandon that pinned choice and switch to the configured default after defined conditions?
rationale: The error-message defect is repairable, but automatic fallback and persistent-session reset alter an existing user's selected provider/model behavior and cannot be safely inferred from one report.

options.title: Keep pinning explicit
options.body: Show provider/model-specific auth recovery text and use only an already configured fallback chain, leaving session reset to an explicit user action.

options.title: Reset after bounded failures
options.body: Define and document a threshold and audit behavior that clears a pinned model after repeated permanent auth failures.

options.title: Add opt-in recovery policy
options.body: Offer an explicit configuration or UI choice for automatic fallback/reset while preserving current session-pinning behavior by default.

recommendation.title: Keep pinning explicit
recommendation.body: Show provider/model-specific auth recovery text and use only an already configured fallback chain, leaving session reset to an explicit user action.

likelyOwner.reason: Their linked work is the only concrete repair effort in the supplied context and touches the adjacent terminal-resolution surface.
